_comment: DOC-DERIVED, not captured. Shapes from platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages ('Define tools in a message (beta)', read 2026-10-09): a role 'system' message whose content holds tool_addition / tool_removal blocks. The definition is 'a tools entry, such as a custom tool or an Anthropic-defined client or server tool' or an mcp_toolset; by-reference blocks name a tool already in tools[] (tool_reference) or an MCP connector tool (mcp_tool_reference, mcp_toolset_reference). Header: inline-tools-2026-09-15 (by value and by reference); mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01 covers by-reference only. Claude Code 2.1.295 sends tool_addition for MCP tools that connect late (mcp_late_tool_additions, behind a feature gate); two local capture runs got none, the owner's live session on 2026-10-09 got Anthropic's 'tool_addition blocks require anthropic-beta: inline-tools-2026-09-15'.
